fact: Law n° 52-2020 of 29 September 2020 defines the national land cadastre as paper-form documents: printed plan sheets, a register-form cadastral matrix and the land book kept by the mortgage and land registry.
title: Loi n° 52-2020 du 29 septembre 2020 portant institution du cadastre national foncier
publisher: Journal officiel de la République du Congo
